name: Cinturato Road TLR

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: The Cinturato Road TLR page does not state where it is made.

positioning: Protection-first tubeless tire for long distances and mixed surfaces, with a reinforced 60 TPI casing.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli claims the SmartNET Silica compound gives highly reliable wet grip.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; no mainland China listing was checked for this line; North American availability not verified in this pass.

caveats: Bicycle Rolling Resistance's results for the earlier Cinturato Velo are not applied to this model.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated on the product page.

image.shown: Cinturato Road TLR sidewall as pictured in Pirelli's catalogue; one photo covers every width.
